taskAnchor.targetDefect: N308 requires environmentConstraints in prose, but N308 and N309 omit execution context from the executable closure root and verifier comparison
taskAnchor.userLastConstraint: Learning must become executable Task Anchor, Delivery Receipt, Regression Case, verifier gate, audit rule, automatic check, or explicit state semantics rather than remaining in notes.

treating mutable latest browser, toolchain, or renderer settings as equivalent to the anchored context

trigger: Component bytes, declared inputs, exclusion policy, and adapter remain identical while a declared identity-bearing execution-context value changes.
expected: A versioned execution-context profile selects bounded identity fields; resolved values and profile digest participate in closure identity; missing or changed fields fail closed; observation-only receipt metadata may change without invalidating the anchor.
observed: Removing the Chromium SwiftShader launch argument left the vulnerable closureRootDigest unchanged and returned DEPENDENCY_CLOSURE_VERIFIED.
rootCause: N308 lists environmentConstraints as required but its executable makeAnchor() never accepts or hashes them; N309's corrected closure repeats the omission.
minimumVerification: changed runtime, locale, timezone, browser revision or ordered launch arguments is killed when selected by the profile
missing required context field returns HOLD_EXECUTION_CONTEXT_INCOMPLETE
observation-only run ID or timestamp can change without invalidating identity
profile identity and version are themselves bound into the closure
fresh receipt binds exact probe bytes and commit

stateSemantics.HOLD_EXECUTION_CONTEXT_CHANGED: At least one profile-selected identity value differs from the anchored context.
stateSemantics.HOLD_EXECUTION_CONTEXT_INCOMPLETE: At least one profile-required context value is missing or unobservable.
stateSemantics.HOLD_EXECUTION_CONTEXT_PROFILE_CHANGED: The selector or canonicalization profile differs from the anchored profile.
stateSemantics.DEPENDENCY_CLOSURE_VERIFIED: Component, declared dependencies, exclusions, adapter, and bounded execution context all match.

deduplication.N307: N307 records the renderer route and phase timing actually observed during a browser run; N311 binds a declared context profile into reusable anchor identity.
deduplication.N308: N308 names environmentConstraints but does not execute or verify them.
deduplication.N309: N309 protects exclusion-set integrity but does not protect execution-context integrity.
deduplication.N310: N310 migrates exclusion-policy revisions and explicitly leaves hidden dependencies as a separate risk.

teacherDecision.source: Bazel Remote Execution API command environment and platform identity
teacherDecision.reason: The relevant external fact was already captured in N308. This regression is evidence that KAOPU failed to transfer that fact into executable gate logic.

boundaries: The context profile must be domain- and task-bounded; do not hash every host fact.
Array ordering is preserved because command and browser flag order can be meaningful.
Network responses remain declared dependencies, not generic environment fields.
Secret values must not be written into receipts; only approved non-secret descriptors or digests may be used.
Physical-device and user acceptance remain separate evidence layers.
This does not prove visual, physical, or scientific correctness.
